# Américaine in France

> > Personal blog by Ellen, an American expat navigating life in Paris with her French husband, covering bureaucracy, healthcare, travel, and cultural differences between France and the United States.

This site offers practical guides for Americans living in or visiting France, including visa requirements, tax deadlines, healthcare navigation, and driving tips. Ellen shares her firsthand experiences with French bureaucracy, pregnancy in the French system, and cultural observations from an American perspective.

## Key Topics

- American expat life in France
- French bureaucracy and paperwork
- US-France tax compliance
- PACS (pacte civil de solidarité)
- French healthcare system (carte vitale)
- ESTA and Visa Waiver Program
- Paris living and culture
- France travel guides
- Cultural differences France vs USA
- French partner travel to US
- Expat pregnancy in France
- French medical system
- International driving in France
- French markets and daily life

## Essential Expat Guides

- [2025 Tax Calendar for Americans Living in France](https://www.americaineinfrance.com/2023/03/21/tax-calendar-for-americans-in-france): 2025 IRS tax deadlines and filing dates for US expats in France
- [French Bureaucracy: Tips for Tackling Paperwork in France](https://www.americaineinfrance.com/2022/02/21/french-bureaucracy-tips-for-tackling-paperwork): Expat guide to navigating French administrative paperwork and visas
- [Tips for Americans Driving in France](https://www.americaineinfrance.com/2022/09/10/americans-driving-in-france-tips): Driving rules, road signs, and International Driver's Permit for US visitors
- [7 Essential Phone Apps for Your Trip to Paris](https://www.americaineinfrance.com/2022/07/03/essential-phone-apps-trip-to-paris): Must-have mobile apps for navigating Paris including Citymapper
- [Traveling to the United States With Your French Partner](https://www.americaineinfrance.com/2022/04/14/travel-to-united-states-with-french-partner): Guide for US citizens traveling to America with French partners (ESTA, PACS)

## French Healthcare & Daily Life

- [Culture Shock: Pregnant in France Edition](https://www.americaineinfrance.com/2024/08/06/culture-shock-pregnant-in-france): American expat's experience with pregnancy and French healthcare system
- [5 Culture Shocks at the Doctor's Office in France](https://www.americaineinfrance.com/2023/11/28/culture-shocks-at-doctors-office-in-france): Healthcare differences between French and US medical systems (carte vitale)
- [How to Get Your Seasonal Flu Shot in France](https://www.americaineinfrance.com/2023/11/07/how-to-get-your-seasonal-flu-shot-in-france): Guide to France's annual flu vaccination campaign via Assurance Maladie
- [Practical Tips for French Food Markets](https://www.americaineinfrance.com/2021/10/17/french-food-market-tips): Market etiquette and shopping tips for French marchés
